## Alternative model: nonparametric bootstrap increments (v2/v6) (optional)

This implements the earliest simulator variant: sample each rank-slot increment from the empirical
pool of observed `dlogw` values at that rank (rather than Gaussian).

```{r bootstrap-setup, include=FALSE}
if (!exists("endpoint_bundle")) {
  endpoint_bundle <- load_endpoint_weekly(cfg = CFG)
}
endpoint_weekly <- endpoint_bundle$endpoint_weekly
K_cut <- endpoint_bundle$K_cut
K_max <- endpoint_bundle$K_max
max_rank_seen <- endpoint_bundle$max_rank_seen

if (!exists("rank_panel")) {
  rank_panel <- load_rank_panel(endpoint_weekly, cfg = CFG)
}

entrant_pool <- build_entrant_pool(endpoint_weekly, K_cut, CFG$K_tail_buffer, max_rank_seen)
entrant_sampler <- make_entrant_sampler(entrant_pool)
w0_ext <- build_w0_ext(endpoint_weekly, K_max, entrant_sampler)
```

```{r bootstrap-model}
if (isTRUE(CFG$run_bootstrap_model)) {

  increment_pools <- rank_panel %>%
    filter(rank <= K_max) %>%
    group_by(rank) %>%
    summarise(pool = list(dlogw), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(rank)

  stopifnot(nrow(increment_pools) == K_max)

  sim_boot <- simulate_rank_paths_bootstrap(
    w0 = w0_ext,
    K_cut = K_cut,
    K_max = K_max,
    T = CFG$sim_T_weeks,
    n_paths = CFG$sim_n_paths,
    mu = CFG$sim_mu,
    sigma = CFG$sim_sigma,
    entry_frac = CFG$sim_entry_frac,
    horizons = CFG$horizons_durable,
    K_xi = NULL,
    increment_pools = increment_pools,
    entrant_sampler = entrant_sampler
  )

  sim_boot
}
```
